# Tables

A row may omit its leading pipe, and the delimiter row is what marks the block.

Method | Collections
---|---
get returns a shared reference to the value | HashMap and TreeMap
insert replaces the value already stored there | HashMap only

The same table with its pipes in place:

| Method | Collections |
| --- | --- |
| get returns a shared reference to the value | HashMap and TreeMap |
| insert replaces the value already stored there | HashMap only |

Quoted, the block reads the same way:

> Method | Collections
> ---|---
> get returns a shared reference to the value | HashMap and TreeMap
> insert replaces the value already stored there | HashMap only

A paragraph mentioning the pipe | character is prose, and stays prose.
